current_date: Updated April 2024 (page: 'Adopted Local Validation Lists (Last updated April 2024)')
current_evidence: The council's validation-requirements page links 'LVL Part One Householder' (joint-lvl-part-1-householder-v3-final-pdf) and 'LVL Part Two Major and Minor' (joint-lvl-part-2-major-and-minor-v3-final) under 'Adopted Local Validation Lists (Last updated April 2024)'. It says these were adopted after the joint LVL consultation of 22 January to 4 March 2024. The Part Two cover reads 'Updated April 2024'.

issues.detail: Grokbot's Part 2 link and its Part 1 householder source (lvl-review-part-1-householder-final-updated-31-10-23) are the pre-2024 'LVL review' versions updated 31 October 2023. The joint lists adopted after the January-March 2024 consultation (Part 1 joint-lvl-part-1-householder-v3-final-pdf and Part 2 joint-lvl-part-2-major-and-minor-v3-final, last updated April 2024) supersede them.
issues.evidence: validation-requirements page: 'Adopted Local Validation Lists (Last updated April 2024)'; 'The consultation ran from Monday 22 January 2024 to Monday 4 March 2024'

issues.detail: List date 2023-11-01 comes from PDF metadata. The old document's own text says 'Adopted 24th April' with no year. The current list is dated April 2024.
issues.evidence: Old Part Two cover: 'Local Validation List (Includes National Requirements) – Adopted 24th April'; current: 'Updated April 2024'

issues.detail: Local requirements in the current Part Two list that Grokbot didn't capture: Biodiversity Enhancement (all applications, LP16); Sustainability Design and Construction Statement (all new residential, all major, non-residential 1,000 sqm with BREEAM); Wellbeing Impact Assessment (10+ dwellings or >10,000 sqm non-residential); Viability and Housing Mix / accommodation schedule and affordable housing plan (more than one housing unit); Transport Statement (50-80 dwellings) / Transport Assessment (80+ dwellings); LP29 Safe, Sustainable and Active Travel Compliance Statement (all developments); Noise Assessment (new/extended B, D, E, sui generis uses; residential within 250m of commercial or intensive livestock); Transport Network Noise Assessment (residential next to rail/trunk/40mph+ roads); Agricultural Land (BMV) justification; Rural workers' dwelling justification; Intensive livestock assessments; Loss of employment land (LP10, 6 months marketing); Tourist accommodation justification; Town centre uses sequential test/retail impact; Water Supply Management Statement; Water Resources and Infrastructure evidence; Loss of open space/community facility (LP28) and of education/health facilities (LP31); Statement of Crime Prevention (all major); Section 106 Infrastructure Statement; Structural Survey (barn conversions, listed building demolition); Surface Water Drainage Strategy thresholds (major: 10+ dwellings/0.5ha, 1,000 sqm, >1ha).
issues.evidence: Joint LVL Part Two (Updated April 2024), sections on sustainability, housing, transport, employment, water

issues.detail: Most of the 16 tab_items are drawing-format notes or boilerplate, not requirements. Several include the council's address and phone number ('Endeavour House, 8 Russell Road, Ipswich IP1 2BX Telephone: 0300 123 4000'), plus document-titling advice and a data-protection statement. 'SANGS will be judged against the Natural England's Thames Basin Heaths example guidance' is a fragment of the RAMS requirement.

Outline and Reserved matters are '(none)', but Part Two covers major and minor applications including outline (e.g. Sustainability Statement 'for outline, expected EPC ratings', BNG and Transport). 'Noise Impact Assessment' (air source heat pump acoustic assessment) is under 'Change of use - prior approval', but the source places ASHP acoustic assessment under Manufacturers' Specifications for planning applications. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is under Householder and Full planning but not Listed building consent. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is under Full planning but is lighting-assessment text. About 18 Full planning rows have 'INFERRED' notes.
issues.evidence: Manufacturers' Specifications: 'air source heat pumps (with acoustic assessment)'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are fragments that don't say when the item applies: CIL ('Infrastructure Levey (CIL).'; actual trigger: new build >100 sqm internal or any new dwelling, CIL forms in all cases); Flood Risk Assessment householder ('What is meant by 'Minor Development' in relation to flood risk: 18.'); Photographs ('asset, using photographic, map, archival and fabric evidence...' is Heritage Statement content); Ventilation (a list of product types including 'Caravans o Shepherd's Huts' from Manufacturers' Specifications, not the A3/A4/A5 extraction trigger); Pre-application advice ('consider pursuing pre application advice') is advice, not a requirement.
issues.evidence: CIL: 'Required for new build over 100 sqm internal ... and all new dwellings'

issues.detail: Drawing standard tab_items are duplicated across Part 1 and Part 2 with near-identical wording (Elevations, Floor plans, Roof plans, Levels each appear twice).

summary: Grokbot used the superseded October 2023 'LVL review' versions. The current joint Babergh and Mid Suffolk lists are dated April 2024, linked from the validation-requirements page. Grokbot also missed about 20 local requirements (sustainability, wellbeing, housing mix/viability, transport thresholds, noise, water, loss-of-facilities). Its tab items are mostly drawing notes and address boilerplate.
